Definition: at that time or place; also as a conjunction, therefore
BiblicalUsage: 1) then, at that time; 1a) temporal expressions; 1a1) then (past); 1a2) then, if...then (future); 1a3) earlier; 1b) logical expressions; 1b1) in that case; 1b2) that (being so)
